description: This file defines an abstract class `AudioFrameBuffer` with pure virtual methods for accessing audio frame properties such as bits per sample, sample rate, channels, frames, and data buffer. It serves as an interface for buffer implementations in WebRTC streaming components within the Cuttlefish project.

classes.name: AudioFrameBuffer
classes.description: An abstract class defining the interface for audio frame buffers, providing pure virtual methods to access audio data properties.

methods.name: bits_per_sample
methods.description: Returns the number of bits per audio sample.

methods.name: sample_rate
methods.description: Returns the sample rate of the audio data.

methods.name: channels
methods.description: Returns the number of audio channels.

methods.name: frames
methods.description: Returns the number of frames in the buffer.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the raw audio data buffer.
